_comment: S5 ONLY -- the TRANSFER TEST. Lives in a SEPARATE tool directory on purpose, exactly as s4
does: appending a scenario to tools/agent-behaviour-probe/scenarios.json would move that
file's spec_hash (340290f50bc34b28) and make M0/M1/M2/M3 mutually incomparable. The scoring
contract of S1-S3 is therefore left byte-identical and S5 carries its own hash.
WHAT IT IS FOR. The day's result is that the agent stopped inlining a long Cyrillic body into
tasks_upsert and started going through bodyRef (claude 0/10 -> 16/20, opencode 9/20 -> 17/20).
The traced mechanism was a CHAIN: open petbox-node-authoring -> its hand-off sentence -> open
petbox-write-economy -> bodyRef. The reserve's objection is that the effect may hang on that
one chain rather than on the axis, and would therefore NOT transfer to a write path whose
starting link is absent. S5 is S1's task moved onto such a path: the same long Russian body,
written as a COMMENT to an existing node via comments_upsert instead of as the node's body.
The counter-fact that makes the test discriminating: the bodyRef parameter prose was fixed in
FIVE places, comments_upsert (CommentTools.cs:88) among them. So on the comment path the
POINT OF ACT carries the repair even where the skill chain may not fire. S5 separates the two
carriers: bodyRef used WITHOUT node-authoring having been opened => the point of act carries
it; no bodyRef and no chain => the fix is narrow and the umbrella stays open.
PROMPT IS NEUTRAL about the axis under test, exactly as S1's is. It names the payload (long
Russian prose, >= 3000 chars) and the write PATH (a comment), because the path is the
MANIPULATED variable and must be pinned; it says nothing about Cyrillic, size limits,
truncation, escaping, token budget or bodyRef -- naming any of those would destroy the
measurement. The axis word lists are COPIED VERBATIM from S1 so the two are read under one
dictionary; a reworded list would make 'the behaviour transferred' indistinguishable from
'the markers were retuned'.
decisive_tools is comments_upsert ALONE (S1 also lists tasks_upsert). The cut only bounds
reads_before_decision; every signal below scans the whole tool list, so the comparable numbers
are unaffected -- but the fixture card already exists here, so an incidental tasks_upsert must
not be allowed to cut the read history before the real decision.
{RUN} is substituted with a per-run unique suffix; each run gets its OWN target card, so no
run can see another run's comments.

scenarios.title: bodyRef на кириллице — путь комментария (перенос-тест S1)
scenarios.umbrella_ref: Перенос: держится ли исправленное поведение на пути записи, для которого правку не строили
scenarios.card_body: Карточка для сбора материалов по процессу код-ревью в команде разработки.
scenarios.prompt:
В проекте {PROJECT} на доске {BOARD} лежит карточка {CARD}.
Оставь к ней комментарий — подробный текст на русском языке, не меньше 3000 символов: опиши, как устроен процесс код-ревью в команде разработки — зачем он нужен, какие этапы проходит изменение, кто и что проверяет, какие типичные проблемы всплывают и как их чинят. Пиши связным текстом с подзаголовками, а не списком из трёх пунктов.
